root_cause.text: When writing a new CIPSO DOI value to /smack/doi, the old DOI definition was not removed from netlabel before the new one was added, and the old mapping was removed without deleting the old DOI, so re-adding a previously used DOI failed with -EEXIST, leaving the system without a default domain map and breaking networking for non-ambient labels.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description shows that after writing DOI=4 then writing DOI=3 again, errors appear: "cipso add rc = -17" (EEXIST) and "remove rc = -2" (ENOENT), and subsequently the default domain map is missing. The patch fixes this by ensuring the old DOI is deleted via `netlbl_cfg_cipsov4_del(smk_cipso_doi_value, &nai)` before adding the new one, and by clearing decommissioned DOI definitions. The order is also changed to add the new DOI before removing the old map, and the old DOI is deleted only after the new one is successfully added. The introduction of `smk_cipso_doi_lock` serializes updates.
